sections.html: Hemipsilichthys gobio (Lütken, 1874). Family Loricariidae. Type locality: Rio Parahyba, Brazil. Size: 15.6 cm SL. IUCN Red List: Near Threatened (last assessed 2022).
South America: Paraíba do Sul River basin. Rio de Janeiro State Rivers, Paraíba do Sul.
Unreported in the aquarium. There is no breeding report.

Identification: dorsal series of lateral scutes on both sides not meeting along the middorsal line between the end of dorsal-fin base and the adipose fin; both tooth lobes approximately equal size; orbital diameter 12.0-14.7% HL.

Etymology: Greek, hemi = half + Greek, psilos = hairless + Greek, ichtys = fish.
Videnskabelige Meddelelser fra den Naturhistoriske Forening i Kjøbenhavn, Aaret 1873 (nos 13-14), pp 217 [16], Pl. 4.
